category_title: At-risk dyscalculic pupils with core deficits in representing and processing numerosity
minimal_context: David is sitting in a one-on-one remedial setting and is asked to identify the number of pips on a domino card.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Good morning. Here are some domino cards. Let's look at the dots on this one.

STUDENT: Morning... (He nods his head, looking shy and nervous, and looks at the ground.)

TUTOR: Please tell me how many dots are on the card.

STUDENT: Eight. (He stared at the mathematics domino cards.)

TUTOR: How do you know?

STUDENT: I saw it.

options.A: The tutor gives explicit instructions by saying, "Look here," pointing at the pips, and telling him not to look at the ground.
options.B: The tutor terminates the instructional demands and removes the domino cards from the table for ten seconds during the session.
options.C: The tutor uses humor to moderate the behavior, telling him he has one more minute or the tutor will be bored to death.
options.D: The tutor reassures the student by saying, "It's OK," and physically backs off from the table during the session.
